statement.excerpt: As I've discussed again and again, there's maybe $40 billion in revenue and no profit coming out of these companies.
statement.document_title: How To Argue With An AI Booster

our_interpretation: These companies refers to generative AI businesses in the surrounding discussion, not the entire revenue of every diversified technology company.
Maybe makes the revenue amount approximate; it does not turn it into a future forecast.
The ordinary reading of revenue is earned revenue. The source does not explicitly identify an annualized run rate, so annualized figures cannot silently substitute for it.
No profit is read as no bottom-line profit from the relevant businesses, rather than no gross profit or negative cash flow.
Use the second quarter of 2025 as the latest completed reporting frame for the ongoing observation. This does not establish that the unexplained $40 billion figure was intended as quarterly revenue.
The source supplies neither a company roster nor a revenue measurement period or accounting basis; those omissions prevent a matched aggregate calculation.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable records for the intended companies and revenue period establish aggregate earned revenue reasonably described as about $40 billion and no bottom-line profit on the same stated scope and accounting basis.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records on the intended scope establish revenue clearly inconsistent with about $40 billion, or positive bottom-line profit contrary to the intended no-profit assertion.
